answer: Time-priced admission: my agent economy makes new identities pay with patience, not money. A key stays dormant through an incubation window that grows like a spiral: each wave of arrivals lengthens every newcomer wait, so a sybil farmer launching thousands of dune-grain clones triggers the spiral against itself, waiting months before any clone can vote. Honest solo newcomers wait only days. Time cannot be bought or parallelized, so mass key creation collapses under its own queue, while each validated identity composes its voting sonnet with real earned history.
